title: Marshall Bromley 150 duyuruldu: 40 saat pil ömrü ve taşınabilir tasarım
summary: Marshall, bugüne kadarki en küçük parti hoparlörü Bromley 150'yi tanıttı. 40 saat pil ömrü sunan cihaz, 499,99 dolar fiyat etiketiyle ön siparişe açıldı.
body:
Marshall, parti odaklı serisinin en küçük ve en taşınabilir üyesi olan yeni **Marshall Bromley 150** modelini duyurdu. SoundGuys ve Engadget'ın aktardığına göre, daha büyük Bromley serisi hoparlörlere kıyasla çok daha hafif olan bu yeni cihaz, 6,5 kilogramlık ağırlığı ve kompakt boyutlarıyla dikkat çekiyor. Model, markanın klasik siyah ve bronz renk tasarımını taşırken, ön kısımda müzikle eş zamanlı hareket eden entegre sahne ışıklarını da daha büyük modellerden ödünç alıyor.

## Teknik özellikler ve bağlantı seçenekleri

What Hi-Fi'ın haberine göre cihaz, dört sürücülü yapıyı besleyen 200 wattlık Class D amplifikasyonla birlikte geliyor ve her yöne ses yayan 360 derecelik bir ses alanı sunuyor. IP55 sertifikası sayesinde suya ve toza karşı dayanıklılık sunan hoparlör, Bluetooth 5.3 ve Auracast desteğinin yanı sıra USB-C, 3,5 mm AUX, 6,5 mm jak ve iki adet XLR girişi barındırıyor. Böylece kullanıcılar mikrofon ve enstrüman bağlayarak cihazı karaoke veya doğaçlama çalma seansları için de kullanabiliyor.

## Fiyat ve çıkış tarihi

SoundGuys ve What Hi-Fi'ın paylaştığı bilgilere göre Bromley 150, tek şarjla 40 saate varan çalma süresi vadediyor. 20 dakikalık şarj ise 5 saatlik kullanım süresi sunuyor. ABD'de 499,99 dolar fiyatla (İngiltere'de 400 pound) ön siparişe sunulan taşınabilir parti hoparlörü, 13 Ekim'de raflardaki yerini alacak.

**Neden önemli?** Marshall, popüler parti serisinin daha küçük ve taşınabilir bir versiyonunu sunarak, büyük boyutlu cihazların sunduğu performansı daha hafif bir gövdede taşımak isteyen kullanıcıları hedefliyor.

source_texts.text:

Marshall's new Bromley 150 party speaker offers 40 hours of playback and is actually 'portable'
Sep 29, 2026 — 8:00 AM ET
- Marshall has announced a new Bromley 150 portable party speaker.
- The speaker weighs only 6.5kg and is much easier to lug around than previous models in the series.
- It supports Auracast and offers a host of wired playback options, including USB-C, XLR, 6.35mm, and 3.5mm interfaces.
Marshall has a broad range of speakers, but its Bromley speakers easily outpace the rest. Despite being hailed as portable party speakers, the Bromley 750 and Bromley 450 are pretty hefty party speakers that let you play audio from a variety of wired and wireless sources. Today, Marshall is adding a third option to the series, and this one offers a little less power but a lot more convenience in terms of portability.
Despite its boxy design, the new Bromley 150 is claimed to deliver a 360º soundscape, where it delivers audio in all directions instead of just firing it in the front. For this, it uses a “patented acoustic design” inspired by professional recording equipment. The speaker packs a 6.5-inch 40W woofer, two 2.5-inch full-range drivers rated at 6W each, and a passive radiator. A 90W Class D amplifier powers the woofer, and two more 55W amps drive the full-range drivers.
The company claims a maximum sound pressure level of 95dB, a touch less than the Bromley 450, which is impressive considering its much smaller dimensions. Talking of which, the Bromley 150 measures just 290 x 290 x 208 mm and weighs only 6.5 kilos (~14.3 lbs). It gets a rugged design with the classic Marshall black-and-bronze paint job while also borrowing the stage-light feature from bigger models. The speaker is rated at IP55, offering decent water resistance, and lets you swap out the battery lid, dial caps, and buttons when they wear out.
Connectivity still remains the new speaker’s strong point, with the Bromley 150 supporting wireless audio over Bluetooth 5.3, including support for Auracast. The speaker lets you input audio via a 6.35mm jack, two XLR inputs, USB-C, and a 3.5mm AUX-in.
Marshall does not specify the battery capacity but claims the speaker can last up to 40 hours of playback. A full recharge takes roughly three hours, while a 20-minute charge offers five hours of playback. The battery, too, like the other wearable parts, is swappable.
The Marshall Bromley 150 is up for pre-order starting today and will be available to buy starting October 13. The speaker is priced at $499.99 in the US.

source_texts.title: Marshall just revealed its smallest party speaker yet
source_texts.summary: I guess "reasonably-sized gathering speaker" doesn't have the same ring.
source_texts.text:
Marshall just revealed its smallest party speaker yet
The Bromley 150 weighs just 14 pounds, with a battery that lasts 40 hours.
Marshall just introduced another party speaker in its Bromley lineup. The Bromley 150 is "the smallest and most portable" party speaker the company has ever made. It weighs just 14 pounds and is around half the size of the Bromley 450, which was already on the smaller side.
It still looks like a Bromley speaker, with lights on the front and that classic Marshall aesthetic. The 150 is small, but still looks fairly mighty. It offers true stereo sound and two inputs with independent volume knobs for microphones and instruments. The device also features a physical EQ, with no app necessary.
This is primarily intended as a portable party speaker, so there's a built-in handle. It's also both dirt- and splash-resistant, in case it ends up at some kind of Fyre Festival-type scenario. The battery lasts around 40 hours per charge, which is a mighty fine metric.
The Bromley 150 is available to preorder right now, though shipments don't go out until October 13. It costs $500, which is expensive but still $300 less than the 450. If that's too rich for your blood, the Marshall Stockwell III costs $250. That one isn't a party speaker, so it's likely to lack a bit of volume in comparison to the Bromley line.

source_texts.text:
British audio brand Marshall has launched its latest party-ready Bluetooth speaker, the Bromley 150.
Acting as the newest and most portable addition to the brand’s party-focused speaker line-up, the new unit packs 200 watts of Class D amplification driving a four-driver array to produce “rich mids, detailed highs, and deep bass”.
Those drivers are backed by Marshall’s ‘Stereophonic 360 sound’ technology, which seeks to emulate the immersive feel of a live performance by creating a more omnidirectional sound that remains consistent at any angle.
The Bromley 150 carries the same design language as its 750 and Bromley 450 stablemates, with a mounted control panel accompanied by integrated stage lights which sit behind the grille and move in sync with your music.
The new speaker boasts more than 40 hours of playtime on a single charge, with a 20-minute charge granting 5 hours of playtime. An IP55 certification and a silicone cover offer protection against water and dust ingress, while a retractable carry handle further adds to the (reasonably) compact Bromley 150’s portable credentials.
Like its bigger brothers, the new speaker offers microphone and instrument inputs via its combined XLR/6.3mm jack, so you can use it for impromptu karaoke and jamming sessions alongside day-to-day listening. For pure audio inputs, a 3.5mm auxiliary port is available alongside USB-C.
According to Emma Rydahl, Marshall’s Senior Industrial Designer: “Bromley 150 delivers the same exceptional performance and craftsmanship as the Bromley 450 and 750 in a more compact form. By repositioning the control panel to the side while retaining the tactile controls users love, we’ve freed up the entire front panel for what matters most: powerful sound and immersive stage lighting.”

The Marshall Bromely 150 will be available for general sale on 13th of October in its ‘Black and Brass’ colourway, priced at £400. That’s a good chunk more than the Award-winning JBL Xtreme 5 (£330 / $400).
